_comment: This repository INSTANTIATES the smart-base harness, as litlfred/smart-trust's and litlfred/smart-immunizations' seeds do (folio-assistant beans rbz3 and n3ni). The owner's rule (litlfred/folio-assistant#1767, 2026-10-01): 'every repo gets same <stub=smart-base>.config.json and smart-base/ dir ... where all the dirs live'. Here the instance IS the harness: smart-base/ holds its declaration (smart-base/smart-base.json), schemas, skills, scripts, tools, processes, kinds, themes, translations, the artefact index and the library of WHO source publications, with their history carried from folio-assistant's smart-base/ (n3ni stage E; owner, 2026-10-06). The generated docs/ pages are not copied: they are rebuilt. The IG source stays where the IG Publisher expects it (input/, sushi-config.yaml). The site is built here by `.github/workflows/folio-site.yml`, which until folio-assistant subscribes to this repository (stage F) still reads the instance from the folio-assistant submodule (`folio-assistant/smart-base/`), so the two copies must not diverge; nothing under smart-base/ runs standalone yet, which is the expected state of a seed.
_contentType_comment: `document`. The IG's pages and artefact index are structured prose and data; there is no Lean and no TeX.
